Hi Stephanie — great to chat. Confirming details below so you have what you need to map the approval trajectory: 

1) Commercial path: our procurement preference for new vendor platforms is generally a PO through our AP system. Marketplace purchases are possible but require approvals from our cloud procurement lead and add extra reconciling work. For a pilot, procurement will accept either but will prioritize PO.

2) Budget owner / economic buyer: Rajesh Patel, Head of Finance (r.patel@silverpine.com). He owns the AI/automation line items. He will be our finance sponsor and primary economic approver.

3) Procurement contact: procurement@silverpine.com (Ops lead: Marco Alvarez, marco.alvarez@silverpine.com). They will issue the PO and coordinate net-30 terms.

4) Legal / timeline: Legal prefers to review using our standard vendor addendum template — expect ~10 business days for review once we get your redlines. If you can provide a concise one-page SOW and commercial summary it will accelerate the process. 

5) Signatory path: CFO or delegated VP-level signatory for agreements > $100k. For pilot under $50k, Director-level signoff (Rajesh can delegate).

Attaching the RFP we shared and a brief procurement intake form.

Attachments: Silverpine_RFP_Q3.pdf, SP_Procurement_Intake.docx
